race.comment: HEROIC TALENT (4) brings the most convincing recent form, with placings at Emerald at his past two runs and clear merit in the latest when beaten just under two lengths after racing keenly and wide throughout as favourite. He has already had AGNAR behind him from that meeting and looks the runner with the strongest exposed BM50 profile. AGNAR (2) is the main danger third-up, having stayed on for fourth at Emerald after being slow away, and his overall record of one win and four places from seven starts keeps him right in the contest despite the 1400m being a small query. PAMPUNI (11) was beaten five lengths as favourite at Emerald but raced wide throughout and had been beaten only a nose at Twin Hills two back, so she has the right recent substance to rebound. MOONSPELL (6) comes through a different line after a four-length Mdn win at Eidsvold, and while this is a sterner BM50 test, her 1400m record gives her a genuine place chance. BOOM CRUSHER (9) can do better than last start.
